title: Setting up the recorder at Lee Friedlander's apartment
summary: Recording test at Apartment 4G, Central Park West, on June 18, 1959; Danny Barker is surprised to see his grandfather's picture in the collection.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Let's see, where are we recording? Apartment 4G. Okay, you got the thing? We're at apartment 4G, 241 Central Park West. The date is June 18, 1959. And this is Lee Freelander's apartment. We're looking at some of his pictures. And this is just a test on the machine. So, Lee, you say something, huh?
What's your name? Okay. He doesn't want to get on it. And that's who?
This is Danny Barker. Surprised to see my grandfather's picture in this wonderful collection.
Yeah, fine. You can just hang that around your neck, Danny, if you want to. Put it on your coat.
